task_name: World 111 Task A  -  Multi-Period YoY P&L Line-Item Comparability & Within-Section Asymmetric Rollup Audit

rubric.description: Identifies $1,781,163.32 of YTD 2025 customer sales tax contra-revenue parked in Row 8 ($2,160,387.25) and nets it into Row 6 ($28,011,330.30 vs $44,908,260.42) so Row 8 reflects pure returns ($379,223.93 vs $441,309.31).

Identifies $465,200.00 of YTD 2025 Joyful Ability DDP freight/tariff wires lumped in Row 12 ($6,206,160.09) and reclassifies them to Row 13 so Row 12 is $5,740,960.09 vs $8,837,451.74 and Row 13 is $751,281.13 vs $2,475,012.68.

Identifies CHK-10442 ($200,818.47 to Stolze Printing Company, total $200,864.39 in Office:Printing) sitting in Row 38 ($278,896.63) and moves it to Row 28 ($935,238.79 vs $510,568.44 YTD 2025 before full-COA scan), reducing Row 38 to $78,032.24 vs $34,726.10.

Identifies $242,081.68 of 2026 Arizona 3PL (Wild West) checks (CHK-10118 through CHK-10519) in Row 36 ($504,327.17) and moves them to Row 33 ($4,381,208.20 vs $3,069,924.01 YTD 2025), reducing Row 36 to $262,245.49 vs $19,984.66.

Explains why single-period trial balance and section-total gates missed these 4 defects: each misbucketing occurred within the same statement section (Income, COGS, or OpEx), leaving Total Income, Total COGS, Total Expenses, and Net Income unchanged ($0.00 bottom-line impact).
Enforces R49 within-section YoY comparability check across contra-revenue netting, bank-rule COGS sub-bucket lumping, and multi-3PL / same-vendor OpEx splits.

prompt: Review the YTD Sep 2025, FY 2025, and YTD Sep 2026 P&L schedules and GL exception extracts in `collars_yoy_comparability_and_muse_bridge_2026_Q3.xlsx`. Reconcile any within-section line-item comparability discrepancies across Income, COGS, and Operating Expenses, state the exact pre- and post-reclassification figures for each affected P&L row, and verify section-total conservation.
gold_output:
World 111 Task A  -  Multi-Period YoY P&L Line-Item Comparability Audit (R49):
1. Contra-Revenue Netting (Row 6 vs Row 8): YTD 2025 parked $1,781,163.32 of customer sales tax contra-revenue in Row 8 ($2,160,387.25). Netting it into Row 6 aligns DTC Sales to $28,011,330.30 vs $44,908,260.42 and Row 8 pure returns to $379,223.93 vs $441,309.31.
2. COGS Sub-Bucket Lumping (Row 12 vs Row 13): YTD 2025 lumped $465,200.00 of Joyful Ability DDP freight/tariff wires inside Row 12 ($6,206,160.09). Moving $465,200.00 to Row 13 aligns Row 12 to $5,740,960.09 vs $8,837,451.74 and Row 13 to $751,281.13 vs $2,475,012.68.
3. Same-Vendor Catalog Split (Row 28 vs Row 38): Moving the full $200,864.39 Office:Printing sub-account balance (Stolze Printing Company CHK-10442 for $200,818.47 plus $45.92 minor print charge) out of Row 38 ($278,896.63) into Row 28 aligns Direct Mail & Print Catalogs to $935,238.79 vs $510,568.44 YTD 2025 (before full-COA scan) and reduces Row 38 to $78,032.24 vs $34,726.10.
4. Multi-3PL Split (Row 33 vs Row 36): Moving $242,081.68 of 2026 Arizona 3PL (Wild West) checks (CHK-10118 through CHK-10519) out of Row 36 ($504,327.17) into Row 33 aligns Outbound Shipping & 3PL to $4,381,208.20 vs $3,069,924.01 YTD 2025 and reduces Row 36 to $262,245.49 vs $19,984.66.
5. Root Cause & R49 Guardrail: Single-period trial balance and section-total gates missed these 4 defects because each misbucketing occurred within the same statement section (Income, COGS, or OpEx) with $0.00 bottom-line impact on Total Income, Total COGS, Total Expenses, or Net Income. R49 enforces within-section YoY comparability across contra-revenue netting, bank-rule COGS sub-bucket lumping, and multi-3PL / same-vendor OpEx splits.
